FN-111KD3L-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 365
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 365 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Department of Workforce by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost of the Chief
Workforce Officer of the Department of Workforce to provide the administrative functions of
the Alabama Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) Council, created by
this bill, and staff to provide support to the STEM Council, as necessary, to fulfill STEM
Council duties, as well as hiring an individual employed by the department to serve as the
Director of the STEM Council.
This bill also provides for STEM Council members to receive reimbursement for traveling and
other expenses actually incurred in the performance of official duties, paid in the same manner
and amount as state employees, with expenses being paid out of any funds appropriated to the
STEM Council.
In addition, this bill allows the STEM Council to establish a foundation to solicit and receive
donations from a private organization.
